Traditional anniversary gifts by year mark the growing strength and milestones of a relationship . You can explore detailed milestone inspiration through the [Berkshire Ridge Guide](https://www.berkshireridgeofblackwell.com/blog/25-traditional-anniversary-gifts-by-year-125?srsltid=AU7gw4UvFY_flm2sSr72JN3gs4wkTuCqA3K_B2g4BffJlBefjZE1Awbq).[[1]](https://www.gsdiamonds.com.au/blog/wedding-anniversary-gifts-by-year)[[2]](https://www.berkshireridgeofblackwell.com/blog/25-traditional-anniversary-gifts-by-year-125)

### Early Anniversary Years (1–10)

- **Year 1:** Paper (symbolizing a fragile, brand-new beginning)[[1]](https://www.berkshireridgeofblackwell.com/blog/25-traditional-anniversary-gifts-by-year-125)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/theknot/videos/a-guide-to-anniversary-gifts-by-years/420481980313645/)
- **Year 2:** Cotton (symbolizing woven, growing interconnections)[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/theknot/videos/a-guide-to-anniversary-gifts-by-years/420481980313645/)[[2]](https://www.berkshireridgeofblackwell.com/blog/25-traditional-anniversary-gifts-by-year-125)
- **Year 3:** Leather (symbolizing shelter, security, and warmth)[[1]](https://www.berkshireridgeofblackwell.com/blog/25-traditional-anniversary-gifts-by-year-125)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/theknot/videos/a-guide-to-anniversary-gifts-by-years/420481980313645/)
- **Year 4:** Fruit or Flowers (symbolizing a flourishing relationship)[[1]](https://www.theknot.com/content/milestone-anniversary-gift-ideas)[[2]](https://www.berkshireridgeofblackwell.com/blog/25-traditional-anniversary-gifts-by-year-125)
- **Year 5:** Wood (symbolizing deep-set, enduring roots)[[1]](https://www.berkshireridgeofblackwell.com/blog/25-traditional-anniversary-gifts-by-year-125)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/theknot/videos/a-guide-to-anniversary-gifts-by-years/420481980313645/)
- **Year 6:** Candy or Iron[[1]](https://www.berkshireridgeofblackwell.com/blog/25-traditional-anniversary-gifts-by-year-125)
- **Year 7:** Wool or Copper[[1]](https://www.berkshireridgeofblackwell.com/blog/25-traditional-anniversary-gifts-by-year-125)
- **Year 8:** Bronze or Pottery[[1]](https://www.berkshireridgeofblackwell.com/blog/25-traditional-anniversary-gifts-by-year-125)
- **Year 9:** Pottery or Willow[[1]](https://www.berkshireridgeofblackwell.com/blog/25-traditional-anniversary-gifts-by-year-125)
- **Year 10:** Tin or Aluminum (symbolizing a solid, rust-free decade)[[1]](https://www.berkshireridgeofblackwell.com/blog/25-traditional-anniversary-gifts-by-year-125)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/theknot/videos/a-guide-to-anniversary-gifts-by-years/420481980313645/)

### Major Milestone Years

- **Year 15:** Crystal
- **Year 20:** China
- **Year 25:** Silver
- **Year 30:** Pearl
- **Year 40:** Ruby
- **Year 50:** Gold
- **Year 60:** Diamond[[1]](https://www.connectedcouples.app/blog/wedding-anniversary-gifts-by-year)[[2]](https://www.berkshireridgeofblackwell.com/blog/25-traditional-anniversary-gifts-by-year-125)[[3]](https://www.tiktok.com/@torylemoine/video/7280862623980096810?lang=en)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wedding_anniversary)[[5]](https://www.tiktok.com/@gabbysgiftguide/video/7148542211251260718)

For more context on modern vs. traditional twists, check out the [Historic Newspapers Guide](https://www.historic-newspapers.com/blogs/article/anniversary-gifts-by-year-the-guide).[[1]](https://www.historic-newspapers.com/blogs/article/anniversary-gifts-by-year-the-guide)If you'd like, let me know:

- **Which anniversary year** you are celebrating
- Whether you prefer **traditional or modern** ideas
- Your general **budget** 

I can give you specific gift suggestions!
